about: Whose Anthropic key pays for a Claude call (aiKeys.cjs). Each key is stored on the AI Gateway's Provider Keys page under its alias; nothing here is secret. Per use, the keys still able to pay are tried soonest-expiring first (no expiry last, then file order). A key is skipped while retiredUntil is in the future, after expires, or once usedUsd reaches capUsd. usedUsd is a snapshot as of usedAsOf; the gateway also rests a key on its own when Anthropic refuses it (credit spent or usage limit).

uses.prod: People's texts and everything the deployed gateway runs (production, staging, previews, Lab test chats)
uses.lab: Lab runs, the Tex test set and replay
uses.evals: Eval runs and benchmarks, nightly included
